title: HYDE · Overview
description: The charging service at a glance — what is happening right now, and what the last days delivered. Built for any audience: no protocol knowledge needed. Every number comes straight from the chargers' own meter reports stored in the lab database; nothing is simulated or padded, so a panel saying 'no data' means exactly that. Sessions still running are labelled 'in progress' and never judged. Times display in your browser's timezone; daily totals roll over at midnight Central European time (CEST). Deep-dive dashboards are linked at the bottom. A weekday filter (top-left) narrows the analytics panels to chosen weekdays.

list.description: Narrow the analytics panels (per-day bars, averages, outcome mix, heat grid, calendar) to specific weekdays. The live row and the two "today" stats are unaffected.
list.label: weekday
list.name: weekday

options.content:
HYDE OVERVIEW
Battery-buffered fast charging — live from the site
LIVE DATA

panels.title: Chargers online
panels.description: How many chargers hold a live connection to the charging backend at this moment. Orange zero = no charger can start a session. If the backend itself cannot be reached, this shows 'backend unreachable' instead of a stale number.

panels.title: Guns charging now
panels.description: Charging guns actively delivering power (more than 0.5 kW) within the last 3 minutes, according to charger meter reports. A car that is plugged in but finished (or still handshaking) does not count. Zero is a real zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS "guns charging" FROM (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, last(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END, ts) AS kw_last FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts > now() - interval '3 minutes' GROUP BY 1, 2) g WHERE kw_last > 0.5

panels.title: Power flowing now
panels.description: Total power being delivered to cars right now — the sum of each gun’s newest power reading from the last 3 minutes. 0 kW simply means no car is drawing power at the moment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(kw_last)::numeric, 1), 0) AS "kW now" FROM (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, last(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END, ts) AS kw_last FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts > now() - interval '3 minutes' GROUP BY 1, 2) g WHERE kw_last > 0.5

panels.title: Fast-charge buffer battery
panels.description: The charger’s internal battery (one share per gun side) that tops up fast charging beyond what the grid feed alone could deliver. High = full boost capacity available; it dips while boosting a car and slowly refills from the grid afterwards. Latest reading — the charger reports it roughly every 15 minutes, even when idle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A side' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B side' ELSE 'Connector ' || connector_id END AS "side", round(last(value, ts))::int AS "charge" FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' GROUP BY connector_id ORDER BY connector_id

panels.title: Sessions today
panels.description: Charging sessions started since midnight local time (Central European, CEST) across all chargers — regardless of the time range picked above. Test-rig sessions count too.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), seg2 AS (SELECT *, max(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no) AS seg_end FROM seg), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, min(ts) AS start_ts, max(ts) AS end_ts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS dur_s, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh, max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS peak_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS avg_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts >= seg_end - interval '2 minutes') AS tail_kw, count(*) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS n_power, max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes' AS is_live FROM seg2 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT count(*)::int AS "sessions today" FROM sessions WHERE start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'

panels.description: Energy delivered by sessions started since midnight local time (CEST), from the chargers’ own energy meters. A session still running contributes what it has delivered so far.

panels.description: Average energy delivered per finished session in the selected time range. Sessions still in progress are excluded so the average is not dragged down by half-done charges.

panels.title: Avg session length
panels.description: Average length of finished sessions in the selected range, measured from a session’s first meter report to its last (this includes the pre-charge handshake of a few minutes). In-progress sessions are excluded.

panels.title: How sessions ended
panels.description: Outcome of each session in the selected range, judged from its power curve. 'Completed' = power tapered off at the end, the normal full-battery finish. 'Stopped early' = the session ended while still drawing hard — cable pulled or stop pressed. 'No charge recorded' = a session that never delivered measurable power (includes the software test rigs, which report no power data, and real cases like a car that plugged in but never started drawing). Sessions still reporting are 'In progress' and get no verdict. Charger hardware faults are tracked on the Operations dashboard.

panels.title: Gun utilization
panels.description: Share of the selected period each gun spent in an active charging session (including the pre-charge handshake). Small percentages are normal for a site this new — the bar makes growth visible over time. Not affected by the weekday filter — it always covers the whole selected period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT charge_point || ' · ' || CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'Conn ' || connector_id END AS "gun", round(count(DISTINCT time_bucket('1 minute', ts)) * 100.0 / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 60, 1), 1) AS "busy" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions per day
panels.description: Charging sessions started on each local day (CEST) in the selected range, across all chargers. Days with no sessions show as zero — a true zero, not missing data.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), seg2 AS (SELECT *, max(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no) AS seg_end FROM seg), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, min(ts) AS start_ts, max(ts) AS end_ts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - panels.title: When do cars charge? (weekday × hour)
panels.description: Number of sessions started in each hour of the day (columns, 00–23 local CEST time) per weekday (rows), over the selected range. Brighter cells = more sessions; blank cells are true zeros. Weekday rows cover only days the selected range touches (a 24-hour view shows one or two rows, a week all seven). With the default 7-day range each cell is a single specific day. Green tones are deliberately capped so the count stays readable (>=4.5:1) in every cell.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), seg2 AS (SELECT *, max(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no) AS seg_end FROM seg), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, min(ts) AS start_ts, max(ts) AS end_ts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS dur_s, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh, max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS peak_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS avg_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts >= seg_end - interval '2 minutes') AS tail_kw, count(*) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS n_power, max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes' AS is_live FROM seg2 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4), b AS (SELECT EXTRACT(isodow FROM start_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::int AS dow, EXTRACT(hour FROM start_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::int AS hh FROM sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts)), rng AS (SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(isodow FROM g.d)::int AS dow FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'), interval '1 day') AS g(d) WHERE EXTRACT(isodow FROM g.d)::int IN ($weekday)), hr AS (SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS h) SELECT CASE rng.dow WHEN 1 THEN 'Mon' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tue' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thu' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fri' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sat' ELSE 'Sun' END AS "day", lpad(hr.h::text, 2, '0') AS "hour", count(b.dow)::int AS "sessions" FROM rng CROSS JOIN hr LEFT JOIN b ON b.dow = rng.dow AND b.hh = hr.h GROUP BY rng.dow, hr.h ORDER BY rng.dow, hr.h

options.content:
**Deeper views:** [HYDE · Operations](/grafana/d/hyde-operations) — service health, faults, commands, buffer battery · [HYDE · Sessions](/grafana/d/ocpp-sessions) — every charging session in engineering detail · [HYDE · Registry](/grafana/d/ocpp-registry) — protocol counters, logs & traces

*Times shown in your browser's timezone; daily totals roll at midnight Central European time (CEST). Data refreshes every minute. Panels marked 'est.' are derived estimates — method in each panel's ⓘ description.*

panels.title: The grid advantage — measured on site
Grid leverage (30 d)
panels.description: DERIVED ESTIMATE — the battery-buffer effect in one number: the highest power delivered to a car in the last 30 days ÷ the 43 kW (63 A) nominal grid connection of this PEAK330-class unit. 3.4× means a car charged 3.4 times faster than the grid feed alone could sustain — the buffer supplied the rest. Method: max in-session Power.Active.Import ÷ 43 kW; the live-measured refill ceiling (~43.6 kW) confirms the 43 kW basis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) / 43.0)::numeric, 1) AS "grid leverage" FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Peak grid draw (30 d, est.)
panels.description: DERIVED ESTIMATE — the charger exposes no grid-side meter over OCPP, so grid intake is inferred from buffer-battery physics: the rise of the internal 218 kWh buffer's state of charge between two consecutive 15-minute reports × 218 kWh ÷ 15 min = the power the grid fed into the buffer. Guards: an interval only counts when both gun sides reported (a single side would skew the pack average), the two reports are strictly adjacent (no gap-spanning), and nothing in the interval belonged to a charging transaction or drew over 0.5 kW — and nothing is interpolated. Reading resolution: buffer SoC reports in ~0.5% steps, so each estimate quantizes to roughly ±4.4 kW, and any estimate above 90 kW — physically implausible for a 63 A feed, e.g. a firmware SoC recalibration jump — is dropped rather than shown. Cross-check: the measured ceiling (~43.6 kW) matches the unit's configured 63 A feed (√3 × 400 V × 63 A = 43.6 kW). This 30-day peak is the number a demand charge would bill on. A conventional unbuffered 330 kW charger would need the grid to stand behind its full output instead.

targets.rawSql: WITH body AS (SELECT charge_point, time_bucket('15 minutes', ts) AS b, avg(value) AS soc FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(DISTINCT connector_id) >= 2), d AS (SELECT charge_point, b, soc, lag(b) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point ORDER BY b) AS pb, lag(soc) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point ORDER BY b) AS psoc FROM body), est AS (SELECT charge_point, b, (soc - psoc) / 100.0 * 218 / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b - pb)) / 3600.0) AS est_kw FROM d WHERE pb IS NOT NULL AND b - pb = interval '15 minutes' AND soc > psoc AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meter_samples p WHERE p.charge_point = d.charge_point AND p.ts > d.pb AND p.ts <= d.b AND (p.transaction_id IS NOT NULL OR (p.measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND p.value * CASE WHEN p.unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN p.unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END > 0.5)))) SELECT round(max(est_kw)::numeric, 1) AS "peak grid draw" FROM est WHERE est_kw <= 90

panels.title: Boost energy available now
panels.description: DERIVED ESTIMATE — buffer state of charge × the 218 kWh usable buffer of a PEAK330-class unit, summed across chargers that report a buffer. Energy standing ready to boost fast charging beyond the grid feed, from the latest ~15-minute buffer report (sides averaged per unit).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(unit_kwh)::numeric, 0) AS "boost energy" FROM (SELECT charge_point, avg(last_soc) / 100.0 * 218 AS unit_kwh FROM (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, last(value, ts) AS last_soc FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' AND ts > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2) s GROUP BY 1) u

panels.title: Grid draw while the buffer refills (est.)
panels.description: DERIVED ESTIMATE — the charger exposes no grid-side meter over OCPP, so grid intake is inferred from buffer-battery physics: the rise of the internal 218 kWh buffer's state of charge between two consecutive 15-minute reports × 218 kWh ÷ 15 min = the power the grid fed into the buffer. Guards: an interval only counts when both gun sides reported (a single side would skew the pack average), the two reports are strictly adjacent (no gap-spanning), and nothing in the interval belonged to a charging transaction or drew over 0.5 kW — and nothing is interpolated. Reading resolution: buffer SoC reports in ~0.5% steps, so each estimate quantizes to roughly ±4.4 kW, and any estimate above 90 kW — physically implausible for a 63 A feed, e.g. a firmware SoC recalibration jump — is dropped rather than shown. Cross-check: the measured ceiling (~43.6 kW) matches the unit's configured 63 A feed (√3 × 400 V × 63 A = 43.6 kW). Bars appear only for refill intervals; an empty stretch means the buffer was full or a car was charging. This is the effektavgift (demand-charge) story: the site never asks the grid for more than its small feed.

targets.rawSql: WITH body AS (SELECT charge_point, time_bucket('15 minutes', ts) AS b, avg(value) AS soc FROM meter_samples WHERE measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(DISTINCT connector_id) >= 2), d AS (SELECT charge_point, b, soc, lag(b) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point ORDER BY b) AS pb, lag(soc) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point ORDER BY b) AS psoc FROM body), est AS (SELECT charge_point, b, (soc - psoc) / 100.0 * 218 / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b - pb)) / 3600.0) AS est_kw FROM d WHERE pb IS NOT NULL AND b - pb = interval '15 minutes' AND soc > psoc AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meter_samples p WHERE p.charge_point = d.charge_point AND p.ts > d.pb AND p.ts <= d.b AND (p.transaction_id IS NOT NULL OR (p.measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND p.value * CASE WHEN p.unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN p.unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END > 0.5)))) SELECT b AS "time", charge_point AS metric, round(est_kw::numeric, 1) AS value FROM est WHERE est_kw <= 90 ORDER BY b
